intent: Specify the public API of `adler32::RollingAdler32` (crate `adler32` 1.2.0): `new() -> RollingAdler32`, `from_value(adler32: u32) -> RollingAdler32`, `from_buffer(buffer: &[u8]) -> RollingAdler32`, `hash(&self) -> u32`, `remove(&mut self, size: usize, byte: u8)`, `update(&mut self, byte: u8)` and `update_buffer(&mut self, buffer: &[u8])`. In Lean they are `RollingAdler32.new`, `RollingAdler32.from_value`, `RollingAdler32.from_buffer`, `RollingAdler32.hash`, `RollingAdler32.remove`, `RollingAdler32.update`, `RollingAdler32.update_buffer`; the `&mut self` methods return the updated context.

manual_mutants.note: short-buffer path (2..15 bytes) leaves A = 65521 unreduced when the running sum lands exactly on the modulus
update adds the unreduced A to B (wrong only when A + byte wraps past the modulus)
remove forgets the per-position initial 1 that the removed byte contributed to B
remove treats `size` as the distance after the removed byte (off by one; also panics for size 0)
manual_mutants.after: let i5 ← (do let t ← size - 1#usize; lift (UScalar.cast .U32 t))

manual_mutants.note: B is not reduced after each 5552-byte block (only inputs longer than one block are affected)
single-byte fast path taken for 2-byte buffers (second byte dropped)
block size 5568 instead of 5552: B can overflow u32 for worst-case (0xFF) input continuing from a large A

sibling_mutants.note: smaller deferred-reduction block (4000 bytes, still overflow-free)
short-buffer fast path only below 4 bytes (others take the block path)
remove reduces the window size mod 65521 first (correct for every window size, unlike the wrapping original beyond ~65777 bytes)
sibling_mutants.after: let i5 ← (do let t ← size % 65521#usize; lift (UScalar.cast .U32 t))

bug_variants.note: pre-fix remove computes (BASE - size as u32) * byte with checked arithmetic: panics (subtract overflow) for windows longer than 65521 bytes, e.g. 64 KiB windows (issue #4); remove must be total

pre-fix update_buffer block loop iterates `for i in pos..pos+NMAX` hashing overlapping 16-byte windows buffer[i..i+16] (5552 of them per block): any buffer longer than 5552 bytes panics (out-of-bounds slice or u32 overflow) instead of returning its checksum

edits.with_text:
def RollingAdler32.update_buffer_loop1_loop0.body
  (buffer : Slice Std.U8) (iter : core.ops.range.Range Std.Usize)
  (self : RollingAdler32) (pos : Std.Usize) :
  RustM (ControlFlow ((core.ops.range.Range Std.Usize) × RollingAdler32 ×
    Std.Usize) (RollingAdler32 × Std.Usize))
  := do
  let (o, iter1) ←
    core.ops.range.Range.Insts.CoreIterTraitsIteratorIterator.next
      core.Usize.Insts.CoreIterRangeStep iter
  match o with
  | core.option.Option.None => ok (done (self, pos))
  | core.option.Option.Some i =>
    let i1 ← i + 16#usize
    let s ←
      core.Slice.Insts.CoreOpsIndexIndex.index
        (core.ops.range.RangeUsize.Insts.CoreSliceIndexSliceIndexSliceSlice
        Std.U8) buffer { start := i, «end» := i1 }
    let (i2, i3) ← do16 self.a self.b s
    let pos1 ← pos + 16#usize
    ok (cont (iter1, { a := i2, b := i3 }, pos1))

def RollingAdler32.update_buffer_loop1_loop0
  (iter : core.ops.range.Range Std.Usize) (self : RollingAdler32)
  (buffer : Slice Std.U8) (pos : Std.Usize) :
  RustM (RollingAdler32 × Std.Usize)
  := do
  loop
    (fun (iter1, self1, pos1) => RollingAdler32.update_buffer_loop1_loop0.body
      buffer iter1 self1 pos1)
    (iter, self, pos)

def RollingAdler32.update_buffer_loop1.body
  (buffer : Slice Std.U8) (len : Std.Usize) (self : RollingAdler32)
  (pos : Std.Usize) :
  RustM (ControlFlow (RollingAdler32 × Std.Usize) (RollingAdler32 ×
    Std.Usize))
  := do
  let i ← pos + NMAX
  if i < len
  then
    let (self1, pos1) ←
      RollingAdler32.update_buffer_loop1_loop0 { start := pos, «end» := i }
        self buffer pos
    let i1 ← self1.a % BASE
    let i2 ← self1.b % BASE
    ok (cont ({ a := i1, b := i2 }, pos1))
  else ok (done (self, pos))
